author: whenthesilentbirdsings
title: HIRING COMIC ARTISTS, WRITERS & MORE
content: HIRING COMIC ARTISTS, WRITERS & MORE ↵ We’re looking for help with “When the Silent Bird Sings” and other studio projects. These positions include: Lineartist, sketch artist, colorist, storyboard artist, animators, music producers, language translators, comic writers/editors, personal assistants, video/reel editors/promoters, content creators & more. These positions are paid but we’re open to collaboration / internships. If you meet the requirements listed, then please send a *PROFESSIONAL* email to: whenthesilentbirdsings@gmail.com with the following information: -Name, general location -Position applying for -Resume/Portfolio with previous & current experience & examples -Rate per panel & for 60 panels (+/-) -Rates for services/etc. (be open to negotiations if necessary) -Turnaround Time for 60 panels/other work -Programs / Software used (Clip Studio Paint, etc) -Preferred Payment Method (However, PayPal is what we will use) -Other notable experience / specializations *NO DEADLINE, ROLLING APPLICATION ACCEPTANCE* ‼️ ABSOLUTELY NO AI USE IN THE PROCESS OR FINAL DELIVERABLES. ‼️

author: mostafa_gawad
title: WE’RE HIRING! – VECTOR BACKGROUND ARTISTS
content: 🎨 WE’RE HIRING! – VECTOR BACKGROUND ARTISTS JUMP ANIMATION is looking for talented Vector Background Artists to join our upcoming animated series project! Requirements: * Strong skills in creating 2D vector backgrounds. * Proficiency in Adobe Illustrator or Adobe Animate. * Ability to match an established cartoon art style. * Attention to detail and good artistic skills. Project Duration: 2–3 Months (Freelance). 📩 Send your CV and Portfolio to: * jobs@jumpanimation.com * gawad26@gmail.com 💬 You can also message us directly through Facebook! If you’re passionate about cartoon backgrounds and 2D animation, we’d love to hear from you!

author: philfalcowrites
title: PAID COMIC WORK: Apply to be a Writer or Artist in TRANSPHORIA
content: PAID COMIC WORK: Apply to be a Writer or Artist in the next volume of Ringo Award-winning comic anthology: TRANSPHORIA! No previous experience required (we love working with industry veterans AND fresh faces). Absolutely no costs to apply/contribute. Paid work for accepted contributors. Creators retain rights to their stories! Application Deadline: December 21, 2026! Link in @philfalcowrites bio!
